graph.title: Space Rocket Ride (LEGO 40335)
notes: The minifigure on pages 5 and 48 (hair, head, torso, legs) is not in the official 150-piece parts list, so it is not modelled.

Connectivity fix: the two loose coins (b34, b35) were isolated nodes, which made 3 separate groups. They now have 'contact' edges to the coin box b29, since they are the spare coins that go with the box. They are not fastened to anything. The rest is a single model: the base and the rocket are linked through the rocket axle b43 and pivot plate b91.
Coins: the manual shows 2 coins put inside the coin box (b32, b33); the other 2 lie loose beside it.

Several stud-to-stud placements are hard to read from the small isometric drawings (the roof tiles, the curved end blocks, the 6091 curved bricks, the cone and fin positions, and the side-stud bricks b52-b54 with their plates). The edges give the most likely supporting parts, so some may differ from the real build.
Step 12 sub-assembly is read as two stacked 1x4 plates with a curved brick on top. It is built twice (left and right ends). Copy 2 attaches to b17, b18 and b19, copy 1 to b27, b28 and b25.
Step 38: each of the 6 white brackets b95-b100 carries one trans-green and one trans-blue round plate in its side holes. The repeat attaches copy n to bracket b(94+n).
The crank, hub, beam and rocket axle (steps 9, 13-15, 42) are modelled with pin and axle joins. The crank axle turns in b25, and the rocket axle b43 turns in b91's axle hole.
Step 39/40 and page 45: the black axle pin b123 sits in the pin hole of yellow technic brick b103, and the nose cone b126 sits on its 2L axle end.
